nova-team.title: Trust is the infrastructure
nova-team.description: Ephemeral is designed around a simple boundary: useful clinical intelligence can move forward while identifiable patient records remain under institutional control.

faq3.title: How Ephemeral works
faq3.description: The current frontend demonstrates the complete participant journey while keeping publishing and contract actions clearly separated from the interface demo.

items.q: Does the marketplace show real patient records?
items.a: No. The frontend creates synthetic preview values from a dataset schema so builders can understand fields and formats without seeing source rows.

items.q: How does a hospital enter the workflow?
items.a: A healthcare institution connects its wallet, completes its profile and prepares dataset metadata in the Healthcare workspace.

items.q: What can an AI company do today?
items.a: Teams can explore dataset cards, save relevant schemas and prepare a training-job draft. The interface labels these actions as a local demo.

items.q: Is Swarm publishing active in this version?
items.a: No. The publishing screen is ready for the future Bee and smart-contract integration, but the current experience does not upload files or submit transactions.

testimonial-v2.title: Designed around every participant
testimonial-v2.description: The protocol gives each role a focused view of the same research network without inventing access to data they should not see.

items.quote: Describe the value of a clinical dataset while keeping source records within the institution’s controlled environment.
items.author: Healthcare

items.quote: Inspect schemas, clinical categories and synthetic examples before deciding which datasets fit a research question.
items.author: AI Company

items.quote: Create a shared path to better models with privacy boundaries visible at every step of the experience.
items.author: Ephemeral

footer.heading: Better models. Better care.
footer.description: Start with the path that matches your role and explore a confidential healthcare AI workflow built around trust.
